content: Bepaŋdi Isilaehi yehitubu-lodawek yoŋa me niŋdi ninadiguk
Bepaŋ, du maŋgoŋde sigilulum tinimilaŋ? Metam dompageye inditok kwihita helemahelemaŋ-kube tiluwaaŋ?

Du metamgeye inditok kotigoŋ nadinimbeŋ. Du koomkwaha indi da’walaŋ metamgeye hinek yoŋa nibukahileguŋ. Dagoŋ nihituwaguŋ kaŋ indi du’walaŋ mebop mintaaŋ hatiyam. Du koom Saiyon kweboboe foloŋ indi gut hatiguŋ u kotigoŋ nadisuweŋ.
Memikniyedi Siloŋyotneŋ nemenemek hogohogok u yehitubu-kadakadapmaŋ tigiŋ. Ale du buŋa nemek i kadakaaŋ haliulak i kaweŋ.
Memikgeye adi du yoke uŋgoniŋ u kahileeŋ hali gibitaŋ kakaliŋa nemek kaka tigiŋ. Adi du’walaŋ nemenemek u bekula wendok kibikoŋ nemek nehi’walaŋ fekhikhinit uŋak boigiŋ.
Adi me behepneŋ wooŋ kudup ulitawa tiiŋ nabugoŋ, du yoke uŋgoniŋ’walaŋ bem heki u finaŋgondi fitubukadaka taugiŋ.
Palaŋ kudikudihinit fiŋa ulaugiŋ u memik hekidi finaŋgon eŋ kwadi wapuhidi beŋa ubulaginetaugiŋ.
Adi yoke uŋgoniŋ u kudup kulahegiŋ. Adi titiŋ hogoli hinek tiŋa kwet momooŋ da hatidok kahileguŋ u tubukadakagiŋ.
Adi yadi nihibefofoŋ hinek titiŋdok nadigiŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ bopyot hogohogok indi’walaŋ kwetnineŋ yali ugiŋ hogohogok u wanaŋ kulahedapmaŋ titaugiŋ.
Da titiŋge uŋgoniŋ diniŋ fek nimguŋ hogohogok uyadi agaŋ beyakudapmagiŋ. Kaŋ kobuk polofet nemu hatinimilak. Tiŋa indi’walaaniŋ nebek niŋdi malabumuŋ i nai deniŋ hinek dapmawaak u maaŋ mu nadilak.
Bepaŋ, nai dedigoŋ hinek memikniye adi ninimpekit tihatineeŋ? Adi helemahelemaŋ du wohoge yotifooŋ ganiŋkadaka kube tiyaneeŋ?
Maŋgoŋde tiŋa du indi nihitubu-lodadok mu nadilaŋ? Du maŋgoŋde nibukabeleŋ saŋiniŋge kahilelaŋ?
Iŋgoŋ Bepaŋ, du koomkwaha tububihila mapmenik hatiguŋdi kobuk maaŋ undugoŋ hatinimilaŋ. Tiŋa nai fee hinek mik gineŋ nihitubu-lodaune mu nihitubu-kadakagiŋ.
Da’walaŋ saŋiniŋge gineŋ imeŋgwaŋ wapum u ulopmadiune imedi dombuŋgolooŋ fukufukuŋ looŋ yakumuk. Unduŋ tiŋa Isiphi imeŋgwaŋ diniŋ pisi wapuhi nabugoŋ bugiŋ u yehitubu-kadakadapmaguŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa yeguŋ e’, Isiphi’walaŋ talitimeŋhik u fowa mebi nabugoŋ ulitawaguŋ, unduŋ tiŋa folooŋ u kale kwet fiileŋ kiŋ hogok foloŋ itougiŋdok yembune nagiŋ.
Dagoŋ nadiguŋ kaŋ ime kuyahi kwetfoloŋ sila labuŋa woditaugiŋ. Eŋ dagoŋ nadiune ime wapuhi hahali u naŋgat tigiŋ.
Dagoŋ yoguŋ kaŋ hauta tiŋa mambip mintagumuk, eŋ mele dut muyakip foloniŋ iitdok nadiyemguŋ indigoŋ tuwot ikamuk.
Tiŋa kwetkwet haliulak indigoŋ fekhik tuwotuwot hinek kamekwambundaguŋ kaŋ hatak. Unduŋ tiŋa gulet indigoŋ tuwot gwi nai eŋ mele nai kameguŋ.
Yahwe, du kaule mu tibeŋ. Memikgeye adi ganimpekit hati tiiŋ. Adi yadi me bubuyehi nadinadihinit mokit nabugoŋ, doktiŋa dutok adi nadigambune nemek fiit nabugoŋ tilak.

Metamgeye adi saŋiniŋhinit mokit. Unduneŋ doktiŋa du tiyaugene mu binibiluwaaŋ, du unduŋ nobu tibeŋ adi memik heki yendi nihitubu-kadaka hinek-ku tineŋ oŋ. Memik heki adi metamgeye indi kisaŋ hinek nihitubu-kadakaiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa fiit du inditok nadikaule adi mu tibeŋ.
Indi’walaŋ kwetnineŋ adi meeniŋdi mik hogok kaka tiŋa wooŋ hebihatiiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa du koom indi gut yofolok tuguŋ u kotigoŋ nadisuweŋ.
Du me kadakahi u biyabune meeniŋ noli yehiyali-moŋgofohinaka hinek adi mu tineŋ. Du me fiyewakahi nemenemekdok baniŋ tiiŋ u yehitubu-lodaweŋ, kaŋ adi wohoge kedem ganintiloneŋ.
Bepaŋ, dubo pilaleŋ ale, pilali memik heki u yabeŋ. Me fokohinit u helemahelemaŋ ganimpekit tiiŋ ale dubo u nadisuweŋ!
Memikgeye adi yadi mede wapum toŋgiyondaaŋ medehaki ganiiŋ. Adi yadi helemahelemaŋ kutifiyeyat hogok ya-tiiŋ. Ale Bepaŋ, du yadi titiŋhik wendok kaule adi mu tibeŋ.
